families.title: Pilot: comment list bug and page-size question

tasks.prompt: Deleted comments do not go away. After the author of a comment deletes it (`DELETE /api/articles/{slug}/comments/{id}` answers `200`), `GET /api/articles/{slug}/comments` still lists that comment. A deleted comment must no longer be listed; the remaining comments stay listed as before. All other endpoints must keep working unchanged. Make sure the project's build, vet and tests still pass.

`GET /api/articles` (the application as started with `go run .`) supports paging with the `limit` and `offset` query parameters. How many articles does it return at most when the request has no `limit` parameter, how many at most when the request has `limit=abc`, and which function of this repository decides that default? Answer from the code. Do not change any files. End your reply with a block that starts with a line `ANSWER:` followed by one `key: value` line per key: `defaultLimit` (a number), `invalidLimit` (a number), `function` (the function's name, optionally with its package).
